name: Model files (preview and download)
summary: Puts back together the files a block streams on a telemetry channel, shows the 3D model among them and offers every file to download
help: Wire a block's Live telemetry (or a Telemetry block) in. The block sends each file on the channel as pieces: {"file", "part", "parts", "size", "gz", "b64"} (gzip then base64). The view shows the glb named in Show, and a Download button per file. Pieces missing a while after the last one are asked again with ctx.send(channel, {"missing": {file: [parts]}}), and {"complete": true} when every file is in. Useful when a worker's result files cannot reach EsaSim.

inputs.label: Live telemetry
inputs.help: The files, in pieces, on the channel
